ex.en: Tom is a flight attendant.
ex.zh: 湯姆是空服員。

ex.en: The parking attendant showed us where to park.
ex.zh: 停車場管理員告訴我們要停在哪裡。

ex.en: Please ask a flight attendant if you need a blanket.
ex.zh: 如果需要毯子，請向空服員索取。

attendant.en: a person whose job is to help or serve people in a place

ex.en: Does Tom have an attorney?
ex.zh: 湯姆有請律師嗎？

ex.en: You should talk to an attorney before signing the contract.
ex.zh: 簽約前你應該先諮詢律師。

ex.en: Our attorney will review the agreement.
ex.zh: 我們的律師會審閱這份協議。

attorney.en: a person whose job is to give legal advice and speak for people in court

ex.en: That aim is impossible to attain.
ex.zh: 那個目標不可能達成。

ex.en: At last he attained his goal.
ex.zh: 他終於達到目標了。

ex.en: They attained their purpose at last.
ex.zh: 他們終於達到了目的。

attain.en: to succeed in reaching or getting something

ex.en: The boy put on his athletic shoes and ran outside.
ex.zh: 那個男孩穿上運動鞋，跑到外面去。

ex.en: Owing to the rain, the athletic meeting was put off.
ex.zh: 運動會因為下雨延期了。

ex.en: I think Tom is athletic.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆很有運動細胞。

ex.en: He has a tall, athletic build.
ex.zh: 他身材高大健壯。

athletic.en: strong, fit and good at sports

ex.en: Business attire is required for the meeting.
ex.zh: 這場會議須穿著商務服裝。

ex.en: Please wear casual attire for the company picnic.
ex.zh: 公司野餐請穿休閒服裝。

ex.en: The drop in sales is attributable to bad weather.
ex.zh: 銷售下滑可歸因於天氣不佳。

ex.en: Half of the cost increase is attributable to fuel prices.
ex.zh: 成本增加有一半是油價造成的。

ex.en: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
ex.zh: 一個水分子由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成。

ex.en: Everything around us is made of atoms.
ex.zh: 我們周遭的一切都是由原子構成的。

atom.en: the smallest part of a chemical element

ex.en: You should pay more attention to what he says.
ex.zh: 你應該多注意他說的話。

ex.en: Give your whole attention to what you are doing.
ex.zh: 請專心做你正在做的事。

ex.en: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
ex.zh: 第一個吸引我注意的科目是哲學。

ex.en: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.
ex.zh: 敵人對那棟建築發動了猛烈攻擊。

ex.en: The attack happened late at night.
ex.zh: 攻擊事件發生在深夜。

attack.en: an act of using force to hurt or damage someone or something

ex.en: The Japanese attacked Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941.
ex.zh: 日本在一九四一年十二月七日襲擊珍珠港。

ex.en: The newspaper attacked the government's new policy.
ex.zh: 報紙抨擊政府的新政策。

attack.en: to use force to hurt someone, or to strongly criticize them

ex.en: Sleep deprivation increases risk of heart attacks.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會增加心臟病發作的風險。

ex.en: She had an asthma attack at work.
ex.zh: 她在上班時氣喘發作。

attack.en: a sudden start of an illness or pain

ex.en: All of my attempts have failed.
ex.zh: 我所有的嘗試都失敗了。

ex.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
ex.zh: 他試圖游過那條河，但失敗了。

attempt.en: an act of trying to do something difficult

ex.en: The old man attempted to swim five kilometers.
ex.zh: 那位老人試圖游五公里。

ex.en: This film attempts to break stereotypes and redefine what true masculinity is.
ex.zh: 這部電影試圖打破刻板印象，重新定義真正的男子氣概。

attempt.en: to try to do something difficult

ex.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.
ex.zh: 試著對每件事都抱持積極的態度。

ex.en: I hope to improve my attitude to work.
ex.zh: 我希望改善自己的工作態度。

ex.en: I am alarmed by your irresponsible attitude.
ex.zh: 你不負責任的態度讓我很擔心。

attitude.en: the way you think and feel about something

ex.en: Black Friday sales attract shoppers.
ex.zh: 黑色星期五促銷吸引了大批購物人潮。

ex.en: Hsinchu's meatballs and rice noodles are very famous, attracting many tourists to taste them.
ex.zh: 新竹的貢丸和米粉非常有名，吸引許多遊客前來品嚐。

ex.en: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
ex.zh: 第一個吸引我注意的科目是哲學。

attract.en: to make people come to a place or look at something

ex.en: I've been attracted to rabbits ever since.
ex.zh: 從那之後，我就被兔子迷住了。

ex.en: I was attracted to her sense of humor.
ex.zh: 我被她的幽默感吸引。

attract.en: to like someone or something very much

ex.en: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
ex.zh: 這個地方有種神秘的氣氛。

ex.en: The atmosphere is always extremely lively when eating hot pot.
ex.zh: 吃火鍋的時候，氣氛總是非常熱鬧。

ex.en: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.
ex.zh: 總部裡的氣氛有點不一樣。

atmosphere.en: the feeling that a place or situation gives

ex.en: The asteroid broke up into small pieces as it entered Earth's atmosphere.
ex.zh: 小行星進入地球大氣層後碎裂成許多小塊。

ex.en: Saving energy can reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 節約能源可以減少排放到大氣中的溫室氣體。

atmosphere.en: the layer of gases around the earth

ex.en: She has attractive eyes.
ex.zh: 她有一雙迷人的眼睛。

ex.en: Jane is more attractive than Susan.
ex.zh: 珍比蘇珊更有魅力。

attractive.en: pleasant to look at or interesting

ex.en: The company offers an attractive salary.
ex.zh: 這家公司提供很誘人的薪資。

ex.en: The price is very attractive.
ex.zh: 這個價格很吸引人。

attractive.en: good enough to make people want it

attribute.zh: 把…歸因於、歸功於（attribute A to B）

ex.en: He attributed his success to good luck.
ex.zh: 他把自己的成功歸功於好運。

ex.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
ex.zh: 把你的失敗歸咎於父母是不公平的。

attribute.en: to say that something was caused by a particular thing

ex.en: Patience is an important attribute for a teacher.
ex.zh: 耐心是老師很重要的特質。

ex.en: What attributes do you look for in a new employee?
ex.zh: 你看重新員工的哪些特質？

attribute.en: a quality or feature of a person or thing

ex.en: That athlete won three times in a row in this tournament.
ex.zh: 那位選手在這次錦標賽中三連勝。

ex.en: Tom is a natural athlete.
ex.zh: 湯姆是天生的運動員。

ex.en: Professional athletes train almost every day.
ex.zh: 職業運動員幾乎每天都在訓練。

athlete.en: a person who is good at sports and takes part in them

ex.en: John Dalton was the creator of the atomic theory.
ex.zh: 約翰．道耳頓是原子學說的創始人。

ex.en: We are in the era of atomic energy.
ex.zh: 我們身處原子能時代。

ex.en: The atomic reactor generates enormous amounts of thermal energy.
ex.zh: 原子反應爐會產生大量熱能。

atomic.en: relating to the tiny parts that everything is made of, or to power made from them

ex.en: Bonuses are linked to the attainment of sales targets.
ex.zh: 獎金和是否達成業績目標連動。

ex.en: The report measures the attainment of each project goal.
ex.zh: 這份報告評估每個專案目標的達成情況。

attainment.en: the act of reaching a goal or something you have achieved

ex.en: Look up the country in the atlas to see where it is.
ex.zh: 在地圖集裡查一下那個國家，看看它在哪裡。

ex.en: Our school library has a large world atlas.
ex.zh: 我們學校圖書館有一本大型的世界地圖集。

ex.en: A card was attached to the gift.
ex.zh: 一張卡片被附在了禮物上。

ex.en: Attached is my monthly report.
ex.zh: 附上我這個月的報告。

ex.en: I attached my signature to the document.
ex.zh: 我簽署了檔案。

ex.en: Mary is very attached to the little girl.
ex.zh: 瑪莉很喜歡那個小女孩。

ex.en: The boy is deeply attached to his grandmother.
ex.zh: 那個男孩對奶奶非常依戀。

attached.en: liking someone or something very much

ex.en: All attendees will receive a free T-shirt.
ex.zh: 所有出席者都會拿到一件免費 T 恤。

ex.en: The conference had over 2,000 attendees.
ex.zh: 這場研討會有超過兩千名與會者。

attendee.en: a person who is present at an event

ex.en: Attendance is compulsory for all members.
ex.zh: 所有成員都必須出席。

ex.en: Firstly, let's check the attendance.
ex.zh: 首先，我們來點名。

ex.en: Attendance at the meeting was low.
ex.zh: 這次會議出席的人很少。

attendance.en: the fact of being present, or the number of people present

attrition.zh: 人員自然流失（退休、離職不補人）

ex.en: The company will reduce staff through attrition, not layoffs.
ex.zh: 公司會透過自然流失減少人力，而不是裁員。

ex.en: Attrition in the sales team is very high.
ex.zh: 業務團隊的人員流失率很高。

attrition.en: a slow fall in the number of workers when people leave and are not replaced

ex.en: The war became a war of attrition.
ex.zh: 這場戰爭變成了消耗戰。

ex.en: Constant stress leads to the attrition of motivation.
ex.zh: 持續的壓力會消磨人的動力。

attrition.en: the slow wearing down of strength through long pressure

ex.en: The owners converted the attic into a quiet home office.
ex.zh: 屋主把閣樓改造成安靜的居家辦公室。

ex.en: Boxes from the previous tenant remained in the attic.
ex.zh: 前一位房客留下的箱子還放在閣樓裡。

attic.en: a room under the roof of a house

ex.en: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
ex.zh: 珊瑚礁是這個地區的主要景點。

ex.en: The tickets for this attraction can only be bought online.
ex.zh: 這個景點的門票只能在網路上購買。

ex.en: Edinburgh already offers a busy and traditional city experience, with many historic buildings and tourist attractions.
ex.zh: 愛丁堡本來就是個熱鬧又傳統的城市，有許多歷史建築和觀光景點。

attraction.en: a place or thing that people visit because it is interesting

ex.en: I can't understand the attraction of horror movies.
ex.zh: 我無法理解恐怖片的吸引力在哪裡。

ex.en: There was an instant attraction between them.
ex.zh: 他們一見面就互相吸引。

attraction.en: a feeling of liking someone or something

ex.en: She tried to persuade him to attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 她試圖說服他來參加會議。

ex.en: He attended the meeting as the company representative.
ex.zh: 他代表我們公司出席了會議。

ex.en: She couldn't attend that party because she was sick.
ex.zh: 她因為生病沒辦法參加那場派對。

attend.en: to be present at an event or meeting

ex.en: Attending high school in Korea is tough.
ex.zh: 在韓國上高中很辛苦。

ex.en: Tom attends state school.
ex.zh: 湯姆念公立學校。

attend.en: to go regularly to a school or class

ex.en: Please see the attachment for more details.
ex.zh: 詳細內容請見附件。

ex.en: The attachment is too large to send.
ex.zh: 附件太大，寄不出去。

attachment.en: a file sent together with an email message

ex.en: Children often form a strong attachment to their toys.
ex.zh: 孩子常常對玩具產生很深的依戀。

ex.en: She has a deep attachment to her hometown.
ex.zh: 她對家鄉有很深的感情。

attachment.en: a feeling of love for someone or something

ex.en: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
ex.zh: 你必須在申請表上貼上照片。

ex.en: Please attach a certificate of quality.
ex.zh: 請附上品質證明書。

ex.en: I've attached the report to this email.
ex.zh: 我已經把報告附在這封電子郵件裡。

attach.en: to add a file or paper to a message or document

ex.en: I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
ex.zh: 我忘記在信封上貼郵票了。

ex.en: The device is attached fast to the ceiling.
ex.zh: 這個裝置被牢牢固定在天花板上。

attach.en: to fix one thing to another

ex.en: Mary is very attached to the little girl.
ex.zh: 瑪莉很喜歡那個小女孩。

ex.en: He's very attached to his old car.
ex.zh: 他對他的舊車很有感情。

attach.en: to like someone or something very much

ex.en: Why don't you drop in for tea at your convenience?
ex.zh: 你方便的時候過來喝杯茶吧。

ex.en: Please call me back at your convenience.
ex.zh: 您方便時請回電給我。

at your convenience.en: at a time that is easy and suitable for you

ex.en: Please send us the signed contract at your earliest convenience.
ex.zh: 請盡早將簽好的合約寄給我們。

ex.en: I would appreciate a reply at your earliest convenience.
ex.zh: 若能盡早回覆，將不勝感激。

at your earliest convenience.en: used politely to ask someone to do something as soon as they can

ex.en: A small flag stood atop the tall building.
ex.zh: 一面小旗子立在那棟高樓的頂端。

ex.en: The cat sat atop the fridge.
ex.zh: 貓坐在冰箱頂上。

ex.en: He climbed the hill and looked down from atop.
ex.zh: 他爬上山丘，從頂上往下看。

ex.en: The cake had a cherry placed atop.
ex.zh: 蛋糕頂上放了一顆櫻桃。

ex.en: We will meet at the train station at six.
ex.zh: 我們六點在火車站見面。

ex.en: He is very good at solving math problems.
ex.zh: 他很擅長解數學題。

ex.en: Don't shout at the children.
ex.zh: 不要對孩子們大吼大叫。

ex.en: The ship slowly crossed the Atlantic.
ex.zh: 那艘船緩緩橫越大西洋。

ex.en: They flew over the Atlantic on the way to New York.
ex.zh: 他們前往紐約的途中飛越了大西洋。

ex.en: A strong Atlantic storm is moving toward the coast.
ex.zh: 一場強烈的大西洋風暴正朝海岸移動。

ex.en: We took a walk along the Atlantic coast.
ex.zh: 我們沿著大西洋海岸散步。

ex.en: Athens is the capital of Greece.
ex.zh: 雅典是希臘的首都。

ex.en: The ancient ruins of Athens attract many tourists.
ex.zh: 雅典的古代遺跡吸引許多遊客。

ex.en: The police arrested him for attempted theft.
ex.zh: 警方以竊盜未遂逮捕了他。

ex.en: The attempted escape failed within minutes.
ex.zh: 那次企圖逃跑的行動在幾分鐘內就失敗了。

attempted.zh: 嘗試；試圖（attempt 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: She attempted to climb the wall but slipped.
ex.zh: 她試圖爬上那面牆，卻滑了下來。

ex.en: They attempted the exam twice before passing.
ex.zh: 他們考了兩次才通過考試。

ex.en: I have attempted to call him several times today.
ex.zh: 我今天已經試著打電話給他好幾次了。

ex.en: The police are looking for the attacker.
ex.zh: 警方正在尋找那名攻擊者。

ex.en: The goalkeeper stopped the attacker's shot.
ex.zh: 守門員擋下了攻擊者的射門。

ex.en: The victim could not see the face of her attacker.
ex.zh: 受害者沒有看清攻擊她的人的臉。

ex.en: Scientists measure atmospheric pressure to predict the weather.
ex.zh: 科學家測量大氣壓力來預測天氣。

ex.en: Rising atmospheric temperatures are changing the climate.
ex.zh: 大氣溫度上升正在改變氣候。

ex.en: The little café has a warm, atmospheric interior with candles on every table.
ex.zh: 這間小咖啡館內部溫馨有氣氛，每張桌上都點著蠟燭。

ex.en: The film's atmospheric music made the whole scene feel mysterious.
ex.zh: 這部電影營造氣氛的配樂讓整個場景顯得神祕。

ex.en: The attribution of the painting to this artist is still debated.
ex.zh: 這幅畫是否出自這位藝術家之手仍有爭議。

ex.en: Good writers always include proper attribution when they quote others.
ex.zh: 好的作者引用他人的話時，一定會標明出處。

ex.en: The government condemned the atrocity in the strongest terms.
ex.zh: 政府以最強烈的措辭譴責這項暴行。

ex.en: History books describe many atrocities committed during wars.
ex.zh: 歷史書記載了戰爭期間的許多暴行。

ex.en: She trains in athletics and runs the 400 meters.
ex.zh: 她練田徑，跑四百公尺。

ex.en: The athletics meet will be held at the school stadium.
ex.zh: 田徑比賽將在學校體育場舉行。

ex.en: The university offers a strong athletics program.
ex.zh: 這所大學有很完善的體育運動項目。

ex.en: He got a scholarship for his achievements in athletics.
ex.zh: 他因為在體育方面的成就獲得了獎學金。

ex.en: Her many awards attest to her talent.
ex.zh: 她獲得的許多獎項證明了她的才華。

ex.en: The records attest that the building is over a hundred years old.
ex.zh: 紀錄證實這棟建築已有一百多年歷史。

ex.en: Several neighbors attested to his good character.
ex.zh: 幾位鄰居為他的好品格作證。

ex.en: She was asked to attest to the truth of the report.
ex.zh: 她被要求證明這份報告屬實。

ex.en: The students were attentive during the whole lecture.
ex.zh: 學生們在整堂課中都很專心。

ex.en: An attentive driver can avoid many accidents.
ex.zh: 留心的駕駛能避免許多意外。

ex.en: The waiter was attentive and kept refilling our water.
ex.zh: 服務生很周到，一直幫我們加水。

ex.en: He is an attentive husband who remembers every anniversary.
ex.zh: 他是個體貼的丈夫，記得每個紀念日。

ex.en: I stopped at the ATM to take out some cash.
ex.zh: 我在提款機停下來領了一些現金。

ex.en: The ATM on the corner is out of order today.
ex.zh: 轉角那台提款機今天故障了。

ex.en: He grew up in a religious family but became an atheist.
ex.zh: 他在虔誠的家庭長大，後來成為無神論者。

ex.en: An atheist does not believe that any god exists.
ex.zh: 無神論者不相信有任何神存在。

atlanta.zh: 亞特蘭大（美國喬治亞州首府）

ex.en: Atlanta is the capital of the state of Georgia.
ex.zh: 亞特蘭大是喬治亞州的首府。

ex.en: Atlanta has one of the busiest airports in the world.
ex.zh: 亞特蘭大擁有全世界最繁忙的機場之一。

ex.en: The festival is attracting thousands of visitors this year.
ex.zh: 今年的慶典吸引了數千名遊客。

ex.en: Bright flowers are attracting bees to the garden.
ex.zh: 鮮豔的花朵正把蜜蜂吸引到花園來。

ex.en: It takes time to attune yourself to a new culture.
ex.zh: 要讓自己適應一種新文化需要時間。

ex.en: The guitarist attuned his ear to the changing rhythm.
ex.zh: 吉他手讓耳朵去適應不斷變化的節奏。

ex.en: The Athenian army defeated the Persians at Marathon.
ex.zh: 雅典軍隊在馬拉松擊敗了波斯人。

ex.en: Athenian democracy was an early form of self-government.
ex.zh: 雅典民主是早期的一種自治形式。

ex.en: Socrates was an Athenian who spent his days talking with people.
ex.zh: 蘇格拉底是個雅典人，終日與人交談。

ex.en: Many Athenians gathered in the square to vote.
ex.zh: 許多雅典人聚集在廣場上投票。

ex.en: Heavy snow is atypical for this part of the country.
ex.zh: 大雪對這個地區來說並不尋常。

ex.en: The doctor said her symptoms were atypical.
ex.zh: 醫生說她的症狀不典型。

ex.en: The room was attractively decorated with flowers and candles.
ex.zh: 這個房間以鮮花和蠟燭布置得很吸引人。

ex.en: She was attractively dressed in a simple blue dress.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件簡單的藍色洋裝，十分迷人。

ex.en: The hotel is attractively priced for students.
ex.zh: 這間旅館的價格對學生很有吸引力。

ex.en: The hotel has a bright atrium with a small garden.
ex.zh: 這間旅館有個種著小花園的明亮中庭。

ex.en: We met in the atrium of the museum before the tour began.
ex.zh: 導覽開始前，我們在博物館的中庭碰面。

ex.en: The survey looked at attitudinal differences between age groups.
ex.zh: 這項調查探討了不同年齡層在態度上的差異。

ex.en: Changing the way people recycle requires an attitudinal change.
ex.zh: 要改變人們的回收方式，需要先改變態度。

ex.en: The dog was attacking the mailman's bag.
ex.zh: 那隻狗正在攻擊郵差的袋子。

ex.en: The team kept attacking on the left side of the field.
ex.zh: 球隊持續從球場左側進攻。

ex.en: Stop attacking me for a small mistake!
ex.zh: 別為了一個小錯誤攻擊我！

ex.en: He did volunteer work as atonement for his mistake.
ex.zh: 他做志工來彌補自己犯下的錯。

ex.en: Many people fast on the Day of Atonement.
ex.zh: 許多人在贖罪日禁食。

ex.en: Set goals that are challenging but attainable.
ex.zh: 設定有挑戰性但做得到的目標。

ex.en: A college degree is attainable for anyone who works hard.
ex.zh: 只要努力，任何人都有機會拿到大學學位。

ex.en: The weather was atrocious all week.
ex.zh: 整個星期的天氣都糟透了。

ex.en: His handwriting is absolutely atrocious.
ex.zh: 他的字跡糟糕透頂。

ex.en: The soldiers were accused of atrocious crimes.
ex.zh: 這些士兵被指控犯下殘暴的罪行。

ex.en: People were shocked by the atrocious treatment of the prisoners.
ex.zh: 人們對囚犯遭到的殘酷對待感到震驚。

ex.en: The students listened attentively to the guest speaker.
ex.zh: 學生們專心聆聽來賓的演講。

ex.en: The nurse watched the patient attentively through the night.
ex.zh: 護理師整夜都留心地照看病人。

ex.en: The player is known for his speed and athleticism.
ex.zh: 這位球員以速度和運動能力聞名。

ex.en: Her athleticism helped her learn new sports quickly.
ex.zh: 她的運動天分讓她很快就學會新運動。

ex.en: Atheism is the belief that no gods exist.
ex.zh: 無神論是相信沒有神存在的想法。

ex.en: She wrote an essay comparing atheism with other worldviews.
ex.zh: 她寫了一篇比較無神論與其他世界觀的文章。

ex.en: Thick walls attenuate the sound from the street.
ex.zh: 厚牆能削弱街上傳來的噪音。

ex.en: Signals attenuate as they travel through long cables.
ex.zh: 訊號在長電纜中傳輸時會衰減。

ex.en: Muscle atrophy can happen when a leg is in a cast for weeks.
ex.zh: 腿打石膏好幾週，肌肉可能會萎縮。

ex.en: The atrophy of his leg muscles took months to reverse.
ex.zh: 他腿部肌肉的萎縮花了好幾個月才恢復。

ex.en: The cultural attache organized the art exhibit at the embassy.
ex.zh: 文化專員在大使館籌辦了這場藝術展。

ex.en: He works as a military attache in a foreign capital.
ex.zh: 他在外國首都擔任武官。

ex.en: The teacher praised the class for its attentiveness.
ex.zh: 老師稱讚全班上課很專注。

ex.en: The waiter's attentiveness made the dinner pleasant.
ex.zh: 服務生的細心周到讓這頓晚餐很愉快。

ex.en: You should sleep at least seven hours a night.
ex.zh: 你每晚至少該睡七個小時。

ex.en: The trip will cost at least five thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行至少要花五千元。

at least.en: used to say that a number or amount is no less than this

ex.en: It rained, but at least we had umbrellas.
ex.zh: 雖然下雨了，但至少我們有帶傘。

ex.en: You could at least say thank you.
ex.zh: 你至少該說聲謝謝。

at least.en: used to say that something is at least one good thing in a bad situation

ex.en: I'm busy at the moment, so can I call you back?
ex.zh: 我現在很忙，可以晚點回電給你嗎？

ex.en: At the moment, the tickets are sold out.
ex.zh: 目前票已經賣完了。

ex.en: She is living with her parents at the moment.
ex.zh: 她目前和父母同住。

ex.en: At first, I could not understand a single word he said.
ex.zh: 起先，我連他說的一個字都聽不懂。

ex.en: The water felt cold at first, but we soon got used to it.
ex.zh: 水起先感覺很冷，但我們很快就習慣了。

ex.en: At first she was shy, but now she talks to everyone.
ex.zh: 她起先很害羞，但現在跟每個人都聊得開。

at first.en: in the beginning, before things changed

ex.en: Please put your phone away and come here at once.
ex.zh: 請馬上把手機收起來，立刻過來。

ex.en: The students all started talking at once.
ex.zh: 學生們立刻全都開始講話。

ex.en: If you smell gas, leave the house at once.
ex.zh: 如果你聞到瓦斯味，要立刻離開房子。
